complaint: Our payment kept failing in the mobile app across every branch of the chain.
The corporate website shows the wrong opening hours for all locations.
The menu is boring and dishes cost far more than they are worth.
I emailed the branch last month about a problem and nobody ever replied.
The duty manager shrugged and did nothing when I told him the toilets were flooded.
The shift manager let two staff shout at each other in front of customers.
We waited over an hour for our mains while other tables got served quickly.
The chef put peanuts in my dish even after I told them about my allergy.
Nobody was in charge of the dining room and tables stayed uncleared and unattended.
Our starters and mains were all brought out at exactly the same moment.
The head waiter was snobbish and sighed when we asked for the wine list.
Our waiter dropped a tray and left the mess on the floor without cleaning it up.
They had no lemons or mint left at the bar so half the cocktails were unavailable.
The bar had run out of clean pint glasses all evening.
The delivery app showed my order as delivered but it never arrived.
Dispatch kept giving me different arrival times and nobody could tell me where my order was.
There were cockroaches on the floor of the dining area.
The whole place smelled of drains and the floor near the entrance was dangerously slippery.
The car park had no lighting and no security staff were patrolling.
The CCTV at the entrance has been broken for weeks and the premises feel unprotected.
The hostess ignored us at the entrance and kept chatting with a colleague.
We were promised a table in 10 minutes and no one updated us for over an hour.
The waiter forgot our drinks and never came back to our table.
Our waitress was very rude and rolled her eyes when we asked a question.
The table had old food and a sticky puddle when we sat down.
The busser snatched my glass away while I was still drinking.
The cashier charged my card twice and did not apologise.
The bartender made my mojito with no mint and way too much sugar.
The barista was dismissive and rolled their eyes at my order.
The bathroom soap dispenser was empty and the bins were overflowing.
The security guard at the gate was aggressive and shouted at my family.
The delivery driver was impolite and left the bag in the rain.
My pasta was bland and lukewarm.
There was a strand of hair baked into my pizza.
